summary: Use a color palette legend on the grid edge to fill sprites' interiors based on their border color mapping.
src: hollow sprites with colored borders s
symbol_instructions: palette is 2xN or Nx2 block on grid edge; read direction based on edge position: top edge reads top-to-bottom, bottom edge reads bottom-to-top, left edge reads left-to-right; first row/column is border color, second is fill color
multi_step: Step 1: locate 2xN or Nx2 palette legend on grid edge; Step 2: build color mapping (border -> fill) based on reading direction; Step 3: for each hollow sprite, lookup border color in palette and fill interior with corresponding fill color
notes: The challenge is correctly reading the palette legend based on its edge position and orientation
